name: Layer
description: Manages z-index stacking context layers. Layer creates a new stacking context with a specified z-index. LayerManager provides a context provider for coordinating layer ordering across the application.

notes: Layer is a layout utility with no inherent semantics.
Ensure that layered content does not obscure critical interactive elements without user-initiated action.
Content inside layers should manage its own focus and keyboard navigation.

children.description: Content rendered within the stacking context.

zIndex.description: The z-index value for this layer's stacking context.

do: Use Layer to create explicit stacking contexts for overlapping UI.
Use LayerManager at the app root to coordinate z-index values.
Keep z-index values predictable by using Layer instead of raw z-index in CSS.
dont: Do not set z-index directly in component CSS — use Layer instead.
Do not nest excessive layers without clear purpose.
